artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan to retire nine vacuous _run theorems behind a retirement record, land two un-At widening lemmas, repair six collateral prose sites, and amend C9 register entries 23/24/25.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan's phases all edit a single large file, the dependency-wave table is necessarily degenerate (one phase per wave) regardless of the phases' logical independence: shared-file write contention serializes dispatch even where the work is independent. State this explicitly in the wave table rather than letting a reader mistake the degenerate shape for an analysis failure, and separate the two reasons a phase is serialized (substantive dependency vs. file-contention) in its 'Depends on' justification. Observed on a 15,759-line Lean module where two prose-repair phases were logically independent but could not be parallelised.
